about_the_game:
Behind You is the game for those who want to remember the vibe of indie horror or just have fun.

A robbery that turned into a nightmare

You and your partner decided to rob the most profitable attraction in the city - a dark horror park with creepy animatronics. But you make a mistake, and the robots come to life ... and now they are hunting you.

Go through three stages of horror

🔹 Run and hide - collect valuables while mechanical creatures are chasing you.

🔹 Sneak in the dark - rely on hearing, light and cunning to avoid becoming prey.

🔹 Survive in the maze - evade pursuit, checking cameras and finding the exit.

Uncover the secrets of the park

What made the robots wake up? Who is hiding behind this place? Look for notes, hidden clues and alternative paths to find out the truth ... and, perhaps, get out alive.

Features:

✔️ Tense stealth horror - you are being pursued, and resources are limited.

✔️ Various gameplay modes - from escape to stealth penetration and panic survival.

✔️ Atmosphere of paranoia - the sounds of footsteps, creaking mechanisms and sudden attacks from the darkness.

"60 minutes of pure adrenaline. If, of course, you can reach the end ..."

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: You are being watched. Get into a closed horror attraction, steal valuables and run before the robots catch you. Hide, listen to every sound and don't look back - in this first-person stealth horror, one mistake can be your last.
